profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Arrive Logistics

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
-Administrator for Office 365, SharePoint 2010/2013/Online, CRM 2013, TFS 2013, ADFS, WordPress, and multiple Azure subscriptions/services

-SharePoint 2010 to 2013 Migration of multiple Web Apps & Custom solutions

-Modernize/migrate legacy applications to Azure

-Provided technical leadership for migration of public facing Blog site from SP2010 CKS:EBE to WordPress

-Maintain, support, and enhance 20+ custom LOB applications (from Classic ASP to Azure App Services)

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented internal resource/asset tracking application (similar to CodePlex) with MVC5/SignalR/EF6/ADFS hosted in Azure Cloud Service using an IaaS MS SQL Server.  Incorparated custom gamification engine that paid employees based on usage. 

-Maintain various LOB applications (from Classic ASP to Azure App Services)

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description: -SharePoint 2010 to 2013 Migration of Content DB & Custom solutions

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
-Designed and implemented E-Notification system consisting of WCF/MSMQ Message Queuing backend powered by SendGrid SMTP Relay and SharePoint 2010 Message Lookup & Admin Panel WebPart front-end with Live Queue Monitor.  Processes a number of different HTML templates by dynamically replacing keyword placeholders.  Also developed full suite of Asynchronous Integration tests using MSTest.

-Designed and implemented Centralized Logging Framework for all applications using a mixture of the Enterprise Library 5.0 Logging Block and the OOTB SharePoint Guidance Logger.  Created 2 separate logging façade classes to encapsulate the complexity of using the LogEntry class. Logs were centralized on MS SQL Server using the Database Trace Listener.

-Updated, optimized, and maintained 3rd party developed TFB iPhone app including major fixes, UI updates, iTunesConnect related administration, and App Store submission.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
-Updated, optimized, and maintained Agent Stat/Rating J2EE Struts web application used to rank all agents across the state of Texas on various sales and retention related metrics. 

-Developed multiple SharePoint 2010 web services with each of the Object Models (Client, SharePoint, and SharePoint Services) to provide integration points for external applications and to manipulate List & Libraries. 

-Redesigned the Member Review Web Service from the original Excel Interop usage to the 3rd party Syncfusion XlsIO framework that drastically increased scalability when dynamically generating member policy Excel summaries used by agents.
